title: Small Side Shield & Totem
description: This Resource pack Remove Big shield And Totem And Adds Small Side Shield And Small Totem
body:
Small Side shield And Small Totem is a simple Minecraft texture pack made to make the shield and totem smaller and move them to the side for a cleaner screen.
It helps reduce screen blockage and makes gameplay feel more open and smooth while keeping the vanilla style.
📢 NOTICE: All assets, textures, and configurations in this project are fully original, legally compliant, and customized for optimal PvP performance. Any ongoing targeted harassment, spamming, or false reporting by toxic users in the comment section is being actively documented and escalated directly to CurseForge Support. Let's keep the community clean and professional.

✨ Features:
Side shield render
Smaller blocking shield
Small totem texture
Cleaner PvP visibility
Better gameplay view
Vanilla-friendly design
Simple and smooth look
Includes a small hidden tweak for an even cleaner experience 👀
Perfect for players who want less screen clutter and a cleaner Minecraft experience.
